stories.headline: Iran Shoots Down US Apache Over Strait of Hormuz — Trump Declares US 'Must Respond'
stories.thesis: The US is now a direct belligerent in the Iran conflict, not a mediator. A US Apache helicopter was shot down over the Strait of Hormuz — the world's most critical oil chokepoint. Trump's immediate 'must respond' declaration transforms the market calculus. Hormuz risk premium reprices from theoretical to concrete.

stories.headline: EIA Drops Bombshell: Hormuz Blockade Persists Through Q3 2026 — Obsolete Within 25 Minutes
stories.thesis: The EIA published a revised Hormuz blockade timeline projecting persistence through Q3 2026 with full recovery only in 2027. The Apache shootdown 25 minutes later rendered it optimistic. Military resolution could end the blockade faster — or total war could extend it further.

stories.headline: Ukraine Assassinates Russian Colonel (Missile Supply Chief) in Moscow
stories.thesis: The head of Russian missile/artillery ammunition supply was assassinated 200m from last year's general assassination site. This is not a one-off — it signals a systematic Ukrainian deep-cover operation inside Moscow targeting military logistics command.

stories.headline: Israel Orders Full Evacuation of Tyre — Cabinet Authorizes All-Out Lebanon War
stories.thesis: Israel ordered the full evacuation of Tyre and authorized all-out war in Lebanon. Combined with the automatic Beirut strike trigger and Ben-Gvir's abduction proposal, the escalation floor with Lebanon just became a ceiling — this is now a ground war, not a precision campaign.

stories.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable Today at 2x Opus Pricing — AI Economy Accelerates
stories.thesis: Anthropic is releasing Claude Fable (a safety-constrained version of its frontier Mythos model) earlier than any analyst expected. At 2x Opus pricing, it's a premium enterprise product — not a discount tier. The 'frontier AI accelerating' thesis just got validated hours before the drop.

stories.headline: Strategy/MSTR Resumes Bitcoin Buying Spree — Halts Market Panic
stories.thesis: Strategy (MicroStrategy) resumed its bitcoin buying spree, quelling market panic after the brutal sell-off. The accumulation by the world's largest corporate BTC holder signals institutional conviction at $58K support. Shorts targeting MSTR face a capitulation risk if the buying continues.
